IN PHOTOS: Fisherfolk from seven cities and provinces — Bulacan, Cavite, Bataan, Manila, Navotas, Las Piñas, and Parañaque, gather at Mendiola Bridge, Manila on May 29, 2026, the group staged simultaneous protest actions, fluvial protests, and mass programs in various parts of the country in observance of the 126th National Fisherfolk Day, to condemn the worsening food crisis, destruction of fishing grounds and the environment, and the government’s neglect of the small-scale fishing sector. 

📸: Norman Cruz
